import.title: Employee Bulk Import
import.description: Download a CSV template with English, Japanese, or Chinese headers and prepare 12 employee master fields plus payroll bank information. Legal entity and department must use Master Data codes. The system validates all rows first; if any error exists, no data is imported.
import.instruction_1: Choose English, Japanese, or Chinese headers and keep the selected header names unchanged.
import.instruction_2: Fill all required 12 employee master fields and required bank fields. SWIFT code is included but can be blank when not yet available.
import.instruction_3: Use YYYY-MM-DD for dates, for example 2026-04-01.
import.instruction_4: For fixed-value fields, use the CSV values shown in the field guide; legal_entity_code and department_code must exist in Master Data.
import.instruction_5: Manager employee number is optional and is not included in this import template.
